name: LucidLink MCP
description: Reads, writes, searches, and locks files in LucidLink cloud filespaces so AI agents share one persistent data layer, via a local MCP server.

skills.name: Read Filespace Files
skills.description: Reads briefs, notes, documents, transcripts, and project files directly from a LucidLink filespace without moving the data first.

skills.name: Write Outputs Back
skills.description: Writes summaries, reports, checklists, and extracted data back to the filespace as normal files that the team can open.

skills.name: Search Filespace
skills.description: Finds files and searches their contents across the filespace with list, find, and grep tools instead of pasted context.

skills.name: Lock Before Editing
skills.description: Locks whole files or byte ranges with advisory locks so several agents and people can coordinate edits to shared files.

skills.name: Read Audit Trail
skills.description: Reads the audit trail of file activity, such as who changed what and when, once an admin has enabled audit for the filespace.
